_readme: Known findings of the nightly production crawl (scripts/seo-prod-crawl.mts), grouped per check type, in families that share one reason.
The crawl fails only on findings NOT listed here. An entry whose page was graded and no longer shows the finding is printed as "fixed, remove from baseline".
RULE: entries may only be REMOVED. Never add one without the owner's OK, and never to make a red run green.
Key: rule|where|detail, exactly as the crawler prints it under each new finding. Every key sits under its own check type.
Seeded on 2026-10-15 from one complete crawl of production (736 sitemap URLs, 150 discovered links, 14 legacy URLs, the www host).

Refreshed on 2026-10-25 with the owner's OK ("mets sa liste de reference a jour avec main"), from two complete crawls after #102 to #127: 18 fixed entries removed, 14 findings added to their families (counts that moved with the data, new pages, the 410s of #102); /stats now writes its play count with atLeast() instead of a key that would move every day.

counts.reason: count definition mismatch on group lists: the home picker and /groups A to Z show 94 groups and /groups says 47 with a quiz, the stats function counts 96 groups and 48 with a published quiz (crawl of 2026-10-25); owner decision pending
the blind test group-playlist count (83) is written as a group count next to the 85 song groups of the stats function, in body and JSON-LD; seen on fresh cache hits, not stale; owner decision pending
/stats and /pt/stats round with K (73.9K plays, 4.3K songs, which rounds 4,281 up), not with atLeast() or exact(); fix pending
PERMANENT: the dated corrections log (rulebook 5.8) quotes the old wrong counts, and the count on that date, on purpose
counts typed into article copy (4,000 songs, 87 groups) are stale against the stats function; fix pending (fillStats tokens)
